name: janaraj-tnl
description: MCP server for TNL (Typed Natural Language): per-feature English contracts for AI coding agents. 6 tools — `get_impacted_tnls`, `retrieve_tnl`, `trace`, `propose_tnl_diff`, `approve_tnl_diff`, `verify` — let agents look up relevant contracts, propose contract edits, and verify implementations against them. Drop-in via `npx typed-nl init` for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini.
